content: u-blox NEO-6M (GPS-only, L1 C/A) exhibits 'position wander' when stationary; UBX-CFG-NAV5 stationary dynamic model + Static Hold mode reduce it in UBX-native config, not exposed via plain NMEA. Typical open-sky horizontal accuracy 2-5m; speed/velocity jitter while stationary is a known artifact needing threshold+debounce handling at the application layer when only NMEA speed is available (no proprietary static-hold).
